name: wordmark with an underline sweep closes the reel
looks: The bold studio wordmark settles large, a hairline sweeps under it left to right, small stat labels appear above it, a tagline fades in beneath, and a URL pill settles last at the bottom.
build: wordmark-assemble: letters settle on the usual centre-out stagger, the hairline reveals with scaleX 0 -> 1 right after; the stat row and tagline fade in staggered, the URL pill arriving last on back.out.
sound: A soft swell under the wordmark, a chime as the URL pill lands.
prompt: Close on the bold studio or brand name settling large, with a hairline sweeping under it and small stat labels appearing above as quick proof. Fade in a one-line tagline beneath and settle a URL pill last, as the final frame.
